sentences.en: We've been looking at different types of conflicts that may arise between wildlife and humans at the boundaries of protected areas, such as national parks and animal sanctuaries.
sentences.zh: We一直在研究在保护区（例如国家公园和动物庇护所）边界处可能发生的野生动物与人类之间的各种冲突。

sentences.en: I'd like to illustrate this by telling you about some research that I've been involved in recently in the Central African country of Zambia in the area around the Chembe Bird Sanctuary which contains over 300 of the listed birds of Zambia These include a number of birds of prey such as eagles hawks and owls that live by hunting and killing other birds and animals Now most of the people living in the local communities near to the bird sanctuary are small - scale farmers and these birds of prey provide important social and ecological benefits to them.
sentences.zh: 我想通过介绍我最近在中非国家赞比亚的钦贝鸟类庇护所周边地区参与的一项研究来说明这一点。该庇护所内栖息着超过300种被列入赞比亚鸟类名录的鸟类，其中包括多种猛禽，例如鹰、隼和猫头鹰，它们依靠捕猎并杀死其他鸟类和动物为生。目前，生活在鸟类庇护所附近当地社区的居民大多为小规模农户，而这些猛禽为他们提供了重要的社会与生态效益。

sentences.en: For example, a lot of damage can be caused to farmers' crops by rodents, such as rats, which would consume the crops as they grow in the fields, as well as after harvesting if they weren't hunted and killed by the birds.
sentences.zh: 例如，啮齿类动物（如老鼠）会对农民的农作物造成严重损害：它们不仅在庄稼于田间生长期间啃食作物，而且若未被鸟类捕杀，还会在收获后继续破坏农产品。

sentences.en: And the predatory habits of these birds also protect farmers in other ways.
sentences.zh: 此外，这些鸟类的捕食习性还以其他方式保护着农民。

sentences.en: For example, a major danger to rural workers is snakes, whose bite may be dangerous or even fatal, and birds of prey have a major role in keeping their populations under control.
sentences.zh: 例如，蛇对农村劳动者构成重大威胁，其咬伤可能具有危险性甚至致命；而猛禽在控制蛇类种群数量方面发挥着重要作用。

sentences.en: Local people have always been aware of these benefits and for years, even before the sanctuary was opened in 1973, the birds played a key role in the culture of the region.
sentences.zh: 当地人一直清楚这些益处；事实上，在1973年该庇护所建立之前多年，这些鸟类便已在本地区的文化中扮演关键角色。

sentences.en: However, more recently, the sanctuary and its birds have also become increasingly important to the community in economic terms, because at present, after a relatively slow start, tourism has become an important source of revenue for them.
sentences.zh: 然而，近年来，该庇护所及其鸟类在经济层面也日益成为社区的重要资源：目前，在经历了一段相对缓慢的发展初期后，旅游业已成为当地一项重要收入来源。

sentences.en: However, although these birds of prey are protected by the government, their numbers are falling.
sentences.zh: 不过，尽管这些猛禽受到政府保护，其数量却正在减少。

sentences.en: Some of these deaths are accidental.
sentences.zh: 其中一些死亡属于意外事故。

sentences.en: Fatalities occur when birds alight on roads to catch and eat their prey, and are hit by fast moving traffic.
sentences.zh: 当猛禽降落在道路上捕捉并食用猎物时，会被高速行驶的车辆撞死。

sentences.en: Drivers in Zambia have to take special care at night, as birds may regard the quieter roads as safe places to sleep.
sentences.zh: 赞比亚的司机夜间行车时必须格外小心，因为鸟类可能将较为安静的道路视为安全的休憩场所。

sentences.en: Accidental deaths may also occur if these birds fly close to high power lines as they may be electrocuted This is a particular danger in the heavy rain which can occur in the region in the months from December to April And local farmers also pose a threat to these birds.
sentences.zh: 若这些猛禽在飞行过程中过于靠近高压输电线，也可能发生意外死亡——它们可能触电身亡。这一风险在每年12月至4月该地区常出现的强降雨期间尤为突出。此外，当地农民也对这些猛禽构成威胁。

sentences.en: As well as growing crops, small -scale farmers in the area also rear chickens.
sentences.zh: 除种植农作物外，该地区的小规模农户还饲养鸡只。

sentences.en: These provide food for the farmers' families, as well as being an important source of income.
sentences.zh: 鸡只为农户家庭提供食物，同时也是重要的收入来源。

sentences.en: But they're also an easy target for birds of prey, and so farmers may shoot these birds, which is illegal but understandable, or they may poison the birds, which again is illegal and can have negative effects on the ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 但鸡只也极易成为猛禽的捕食目标，因此农民可能会射杀这些猛禽——此举虽属违法却情有可原；或者投毒杀害猛禽——此举同样违法，并会对生态系统产生负面影响。

sentences.en: So how else can farmers protect their chickens from birds of prey?
sentences.zh: 那么，农民还能采取哪些其他方法来保护鸡只免受猛禽侵害呢？

sentences.en: Some people believe that to prevent the predators from settling near the area where the chickens are kept, it's best to keep this area free from vegetation.
sentences.zh: 一些人认为，为防止猛禽在鸡只饲养区附近栖息，最佳做法是清除该区域的所有植被。

sentences.en: But in fact, this is counterproductive, as it means the chickens have no cover to hide in and they'll be easier for the birds to see.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，这种做法适得其反，因为这意味着鸡只失去可供藏身的遮蔽物，反而更容易被猛禽发现。

sentences.en: Another possibility would be to prevent the chickens from going outside at all and to keep them safe from predators inside a building, but this would cost far too much to be a practical solution.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能性是完全禁止鸡只外出，将其全部关在建筑物内以躲避天敌，但这种方法成本过高，不具备实际可行性。

sentences.en: Nearly all the farmers reported that they spent a lot of time and effort trying to frighten off the birds of prey without actually harming them.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有受访农户均表示，他们花费大量时间与精力，试图在不伤害猛禽的前提下驱赶它们。

sentences.en: Most of the farmers had at least one dog and said this was a big help at scaring away the predators.
sentences.zh: 大多数农民至少养了一只狗，称这在驱赶捕食者方面帮助很大。

sentences.en: Some of the farmers also reported that during the breeding season, when the chickens were particularly vulnerable, they encouraged their children to watch over the chickens and to hit pans with a metal spoon so that the resulting noise would succeed in driving away birds that were trying to seize the young chicks None of these methods was 100 effective so as a result the village people told us that rather than just using one method, they were forced to use a combination for them to have any effect.
sentences.zh: 一些农民还报告称，在繁殖季节，当鸡特别脆弱时，他们会鼓励孩子照看鸡群，并用金属勺敲击锅具，由此产生的噪音成功驱走了试图捕捉小鸡的鸟类。这些方法没有一种是百分之百有效的，因此村民们告诉我们，他们不得不将多种方法结合起来使用，才能产生任何效果。

sentences.en: And even so, these birds of prey remain a major threat to the chickens' survival and cause considerable economic loss to farmers.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这些猛禽仍是鸡生存的主要威胁，并给农民造成相当可观的经济损失。

sentences.en: So we looked at the possibility of a longer-term solution to...
sentences.zh: 因此，我们研究了长期解决方案的可能性……
